summary: Wrote a 6-phase, 5.25-hour implementation plan for the sf1 virtual plugin, building bottom-up: snacks-backed window layer, then the dependency-free module core, then spec/loader/:Sf1 registration, then the single shared-territory keymap edit, then documentation, then a verification phase. Settled the three design choices research left open (float omits size and uses snacks float defaults; ai/README.md gains a sapience/ subdirectory entry; set_position mutates a live terminal's opts and hide/show-repositions rather than restarting the REPL) and added two newly-verified snacks mechanics the plan depends on. The plan's per-phase Files to modify blocks harvest to exactly the nine intended paths with neither shared/picker/ file present, which discharges the research recommendation to declare file_scope.
